facts.fact: Max 是前世界级球员，薪水在这支英格兰小球会只比洗碗工多一点
facts.anchor: I don’t get paid much more than a busboy here.

facts.fact: 队友 Rudders 起哄要叫 Max「Daddy Max」，被 Max 否认（他有别的外号）
facts.anchor: Maybe we should call you Daddy Max.

facts.fact: Coach Mike 让他叫自己名字并称「我们是家人」，Max 盘算八个月后回美国再打两个赛季
facts.anchor: reminding me that in eight months I’ll return home for hopefully two more seasons

facts.fact: 前妻 Els 带 13 岁的 Bailey 来看训练——Max 是养了他七年的继父，生父 Ted 曾禁止他探视
facts.anchor: Bailey’s biological dad, Ted, who barred me from seeing him

facts.fact: Ted 多年藏起 Max 寄给 Bailey 的礼物、信和卡片
facts.anchor: the bastard hid my presents, letters, and cards to Bailey

facts.fact: Els 父母以离婚律师费要挟，认为亲生父母最重要，还怪 Max 害他们错过 Bailey 头七年
facts.anchor: They think biological parents are the most important parents.

facts.fact: Henry 建议带 Bailey 去烹饪学校今晚的亲子课，Max 立刻拍板
章末 Max 立誓：这是重来的机会，他要成为 Bailey 需要的父亲
facts.anchor: But I’m getting a do-over. This is my chance to change everything and become the dad Bailey needs.
